title: Oral Health Essentials
topic: Dental English — oral tissues and tooth protection
objective: Identify three common terms used to describe the teeth and oral tissues.

vocabulary.definition: The soft tissue surrounding the teeth.
vocabulary.example: Healthy gingiva should not bleed easily.

vocabulary.definition: The hard outer covering of a tooth.
vocabulary.example: Enamel protects the tooth from wear.

vocabulary.definition: A soft film of bacteria that forms on teeth.

quiz.question: Which term means the hard outer covering of a tooth?
quiz.explanation: Enamel is the hard outer covering of a tooth; gingiva means gums, and plaque is a bacterial film.
